description: Play the Master of Sydney, modern nights. Sarrasine — Ministry methuselah, 235 years behind a Toreador mask — has held the harbour since 1888 without sect, without rival, and without exposure. A Vampire: The Masquerade grand-strategy scenario built on the Open Historia engine (MIT) — Phase Two of her continental design is moving, the tolerated Anarchs are restless, Hardacre's Sydney cell is one leak from notice, and Brisbane remembers the harbour.
heroSubtitle: Hold the mask. Keep the harbour. Outlast everyone.
name: Sydney by Night
subtitle: VtM — modern nights, March 2026
